title: My Brother-In-Law Stole My $90K And Forged A Theater Sale. So I Let Him Sweep The Stage.
description: I drained my $90,000 retirement to restore a historic 1920s theater with my brother-in-law, who then forged a sale and handed me a $4,000 'finale' check. I found my notarized handshake video, blocked the demolition, and now run Stage of Betrayal Theatre where he sweeps the stage in a doublet, and every playbill prints his felony docket number. #FamilyBetrayal #Karma #TheaterRevenge
thumb_text: HIS FELONY DOCKET NUMBER IS ON EVERY PLAYBILL
pinned_comment: If your brother-in-law drained your $90,000 retirement to restore a theater, then forged a sale and tossed you a $4,000 finale check, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: HE SWEEPS THE STAGE IN A DOUBLET THAT READS EXIT PURSUED BY A FRAUD
